_comment: Canonical metro list. slug = lowercase, dots dropped, spaces to dashes (matches FindLocalFE /city/<slug> URLs). FindLocalFE vendors a copy via `npm run sync-data`.

cities.name: Ann Arbor
cities.blurb: Ann Arbor's calendar leans on the University of Michigan — UMS touring classical at Hill Auditorium, nightly folk and songwriter bills at the Ark, and repertory film at the Michigan Theater.

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.blurb: Atlanta is a hip-hop and touring-music town, with the Fox Theatre, Tabernacle and Variety Playhouse anchoring club nights spread across East Atlanta, Little Five Points and West Midtown.

cities.name: Austin
cities.blurb: Austin books more live music per night than any comparable metro — the Red River clubs, the Continental Club on South Congress, and a spring the city hands over to SXSW.

cities.name: Baltimore
cities.blurb: Baltimore's scene is built on DIY and mid-size rooms — the Ottobar, the Crown, Rams Head Live — alongside the Baltimore Symphony at Meyerhoff and Station North gallery openings.

cities.name: Bangor
cities.blurb: Bangor draws arena and waterfront amphitheater tours to the Cross Insurance Center and Maine Savings Amphitheater, with Penobscot Theatre Company and the Bangor State Fair filling the rest of the year.

cities.name: Bloomington
cities.blurb: Bloomington runs on Indiana University — Jacobs School of Music recitals most nights of the week, IU Cinema screenings, and touring bands at the Bluebird and Buskirk-Chumley downtown.

cities.name: Boise
cities.blurb: Boise's nights center on the Egyptian Theatre, the Neurolux and Treefort Music Fest, with the Boise Philharmonic and Ballet Idaho at the Morrison Center.

cities.name: Boston
cities.blurb: Boston mixes student-driven rock rooms in Allston and Cambridge with the Boston Symphony at Symphony Hall, Huntington and A.R.T. theater, and one of the densest bookstore-reading circuits in the country.

cities.name: Brattleboro
cities.blurb: Brattleboro packs a few downtown blocks with the Latchis Theatre and the Stone Church, plus a Gallery Walk on the first Friday of every month.

cities.name: Buffalo
cities.blurb: Buffalo's rooms run from the Town Ballroom and Mohawk Place to Kleinhans Music Hall, home of the Buffalo Philharmonic, with touring Broadway at Shea's.

cities.name: Burlington
cities.blurb: Burlington's nightlife clusters around Church Street and Main — Nectar's, Higher Ground just over the line in South Burlington, and the Flynn for touring theater and jazz.

cities.name: Cape Cod
cities.blurb: Cape Cod's calendar swells in summer: the Cape Playhouse in Dennis, the Provincetown Theater, arena acts under canvas at the Cape Cod Melody Tent, and gallery openings in Wellfleet and Provincetown.

cities.name: Charleston
cities.blurb: Charleston's spring belongs to Spoleto Festival USA, while the Music Farm, Charleston Music Hall and the Dock Street Theatre carry the rest of the year.

cities.name: Charlotte
cities.blurb: Charlotte pairs arena and amphitheater tours with neighborhood rooms like the Neighborhood Theatre and Visulite, and a Broadway season uptown at the Blumenthal.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.blurb: Chicago has the deepest improv and blues benches in the country — Second City and iO, Kingston Mines and Buddy Guy's Legends — plus Lincoln Hall, Thalia Hall, the Lyric and the CSO.

cities.name: Cincinnati
cities.blurb: Cincinnati's calendar runs through Music Hall, where the symphony, opera and ballet share a stage, with the Taft Theatre, Bogart's, and MOTR and the Woodward in Over-the-Rhine.

cities.name: Cleveland
cities.blurb: Cleveland's Playhouse Square is the largest theater district outside New York, with the Cleveland Orchestra at Severance and clubs like the Grog Shop in Cleveland Heights and the Beachland in Collinwood.

cities.name: Columbia MO
cities.blurb: Columbia's nights follow the University of Missouri calendar — the Blue Note and Rose Music Hall for touring bands, Ragtag Cinema, and the True/False documentary festival each spring.

cities.name: Columbus
cities.blurb: Columbus has an outsized indie circuit — the Newport Music Hall, Ace of Cups, Rumba Café — alongside CAPA's restored downtown theaters and a heavy Ohio State events calendar.

cities.name: Dallas
cities.blurb: Dallas spreads across Deep Ellum's clubs, the AT&T Performing Arts Center and Meyerson downtown, and the Granada and Kessler theaters in the neighborhoods.

cities.name: Denver
cities.blurb: Denver's summer is defined by Red Rocks, with the Ogden, Bluebird and Gothic along Colfax and South Broadway carrying the club calendar year-round.

cities.name: Des Moines
cities.blurb: Des Moines fills Hoyt Sherman Place, Wooly's and xBk, with the Des Moines Arts Festival taking over the western gateway each June.

cities.name: Detroit
cities.blurb: Detroit's techno and garage-rock lineage shows in the Majestic complex, El Club and Saint Andrew's Hall, alongside the Fox and Fillmore downtown and Movement over Memorial Day weekend.

cities.name: Duluth
cities.blurb: Duluth's lakefront calendar runs from shows at Sacred Heart Music Center and Pizza Lucé to Bayfront Festival Park concerts and the Homegrown Music Festival each spring.

cities.name: Fort Collins
cities.blurb: Fort Collins builds its nights around the Aggie Theatre, Washington's and Old Town's breweries, with FoCoMX spotlighting Colorado bands each spring.

cities.name: Grand Rapids
cities.blurb: Grand Rapids hosts ArtPrize each fall, with the Intersection, Van Andel Arena and DeVos Performance Hall covering the rest of the calendar.

cities.name: Green Bay
cities.blurb: Green Bay's events orbit Lambeau Field and the Resch Center, with the Meyer and Tarlton theaters booking touring acts downtown.

cities.name: Hanover
cities.blurb: Hanover's calendar is Dartmouth's: the Hopkins Center for the Arts stages touring music, dance and film, and the Hood Museum and Rollins Chapel run public talks and concerts year-round.

cities.name: Harrisburg
cities.blurb: Harrisburg fills the Forum and Whitaker Center downtown, books touring bands at XL Live and HMAC, and draws the whole state to the Farm Show each January.

cities.name: Hartford
cities.blurb: Hartford's anchors are the Bushnell, Hartford Stage and the XL Center, with Infinity Music Hall and Real Art Ways covering live music and independent film.

cities.name: Hilton Head
cities.blurb: Hilton Head's season is concert- and tournament-driven: the Arts Center of Coastal Carolina, Hilton Head Symphony Orchestra concerts, and the RBC Heritage at Harbour Town each April.

cities.name: Houston
cities.blurb: Houston's theater district packs the Alley Theatre, Houston Grand Opera and the symphony into a few blocks, while White Oak Music Hall, the Continental Club and Rudyard's handle live music.

cities.name: Hudson Valley
cities.blurb: The Hudson Valley's venues are spread across river towns — the Bardavon in Poughkeepsie, the Midnight Ramble at Levon Helm Studios in Woodstock, and warehouse shows at Basilica Hudson.

cities.name: Indianapolis
cities.blurb: Indianapolis centers on Mass Ave and Fountain Square — the Vogue, HI-FI and Old National Centre — plus the ISO at Hilbert Circle Theatre and a May that belongs to the 500.

cities.name: Iowa City
cities.blurb: Iowa City is a UNESCO City of Literature: Prairie Lights readings and Writers' Workshop events sit beside shows at the Englert Theatre and Gabe's.

cities.name: Jersey Shore
cities.blurb: The Jersey Shore's summer runs on Asbury Park — the Stone Pony and Wonder Bar — plus boardwalk festivals and Count Basie Center shows in Red Bank.

cities.name: Kansas City
cities.blurb: Kansas City's jazz history still plays in the 18th & Vine district, while the Uptown Theater, recordBar and the Kauffman Center cover touring music and the symphony.

cities.name: Lansing
cities.blurb: Lansing's calendar mixes Michigan State events at the Wharton Center and Breslin with downtown shows at the Avenue Café and Grewal Hall.

cities.name: Las Vegas
cities.blurb: Las Vegas runs on residencies and production shows along the Strip, with Fremont Street, the Smith Center and Area15 booking the nights that happen off it.

cities.name: Lincoln
cities.blurb: Lincoln's nights split between Husker crowds at Memorial Stadium and Pinnacle Bank Arena and clubs like the Bourbon Theatre and the Zoo Bar's long-running blues bills.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.blurb: Los Angeles has the widest range of any US metro — the Hollywood Bowl and Disney Hall, stand-up at the Comedy Store and UCB, and club nights from the Echo to the Troubadour.

cities.name: Madison
cities.blurb: Madison's calendar runs along State Street — the Majestic, High Noon Saloon and Overture Center — with UW-Madison lectures and the Saturday farmers' market circling the Capitol.

cities.name: Manchester
cities.blurb: Manchester books arena tours at SNHU Arena and resident seasons at the Palace Theatre, with rock and comedy nights at Jewel and the Shaskeen.

cities.name: Miami
cities.blurb: Miami's calendar is Latin-music and festival heavy: Ultra and Art Basel bookend the year, with the Arsht Center, Ball & Chain and North Beach's live rooms in between.

cities.name: Milwaukee
cities.blurb: Milwaukee claims Summerfest, the largest music festival in the country, plus the Pabst and Riverside theaters and Turner Hall Ballroom downtown.

cities.name: Minneapolis
cities.blurb: Minneapolis's rock circuit — First Avenue, the Turf Club, the Cedar Cultural Center — sits beside the Guthrie's theater seasons and the Minnesota Orchestra at Orchestra Hall.

cities.name: Nashville
cities.blurb: Nashville has live music from noon on Lower Broadway, songwriter rounds at the Bluebird Café, and the Ryman and Grand Ole Opry booking most nights of the week.

cities.name: New Haven
cities.blurb: New Haven's rooms include Toad's Place, College Street Music Hall and Yale Repertory Theatre, with Yale lectures and Beinecke exhibits open to anyone who walks in.

cities.name: New Orleans
cities.blurb: New Orleans has brass bands on Frenchmen Street most nights, traditional sets at Preservation Hall, and a festival calendar running from Mardi Gras through Jazz Fest.

cities.name: New York
cities.blurb: New York carries Broadway and off-Broadway, jazz at the Village Vanguard and Blue Note, comedy cellars in the Village, and club nights across Brooklyn and Queens.

cities.name: Northampton
cities.blurb: Northampton's small downtown holds the Iron Horse, the Academy of Music and the Calvin Theatre, with Smith College talks and Broadside Bookshop readings alongside them.

cities.name: Oklahoma City
cities.blurb: Oklahoma City's Bricktown and Plaza District carry the club calendar — the Tower Theatre, Beer City Music Hall — while the Civic Center hosts ballet, opera and touring Broadway.

cities.name: Orlando
cities.blurb: Orlando's events split between the theme parks' seasonal festivals and a local scene at the Social, Will's Pub and the Dr. Phillips Center downtown.

cities.name: Philadelphia
cities.blurb: Philadelphia's rooms run from Union Transfer and Johnny Brenda's in Fishtown to the Kimmel Center and the Mann, with First Friday openings in Old City.

cities.name: Phoenix
cities.blurb: Phoenix's outdoor season peaks in winter, with Crescent Ballroom, Valley Bar and the Van Buren downtown and spring training filling March.

cities.name: Pittsburgh
cities.blurb: Pittsburgh's Cultural District packs Heinz Hall, the Benedum and the Byham into a few blocks, with Mr. Smalls in Millvale and Thunderbird in Lawrenceville on the other side of the river.

cities.name: Pittsfield
cities.blurb: Pittsfield anchors Berkshire summers with the Colonial Theatre and Barrington Stage, minutes from Tanglewood in Lenox and Jacob's Pillow in Becket.

cities.name: Portland
cities.blurb: Portland's calendar is dense with small rooms — Doug Fir, Mississippi Studios, Revolution Hall — plus Powell's author readings and the Schnitz for touring acts.

cities.name: Portland ME
cities.blurb: Portland's waterfront books the State Theatre and Aura, with Portland Stage, SPACE and the First Friday Art Walk rounding out the month.

cities.name: Portsmouth
cities.blurb: Portsmouth's compact downtown holds the Music Hall, 3S Artspace and the Press Room, with an outdoor summer season at Prescott Park on the river.

cities.name: Providence
cities.blurb: Providence pairs RISD and Brown events with the Columbus Theatre, AS220 and Trinity Rep, and lights the rivers for WaterFire on summer nights.

cities.name: Raleigh
cities.blurb: Raleigh's calendar spans the Lincoln Theatre and Kings downtown, amphitheater tours at Coastal Credit Union Music Park, and Hopscotch Music Festival each September.

cities.name: Rochester
cities.blurb: Rochester's Eastman School of Music fills recital halls almost nightly, with the Bug Jar and Anthology booking rock and the Rochester International Jazz Festival in June.

cities.name: Rockland
cities.blurb: Rockland's midcoast calendar runs through the Strand Theatre, Farnsworth Art Museum openings and the Maine Lobster Festival in August.

cities.name: Rutland
cities.blurb: Rutland's events center on the restored Paramount Theatre downtown, with Killington-area concerts and the Vermont State Fair each September.

cities.name: Sacramento
cities.blurb: Sacramento's Midtown clubs — Harlow's, Goldfield, the Torch Club — sit beside Crest Theatre film runs and Concerts in the Park on spring Fridays.

cities.name: Salt Lake City
cities.blurb: Salt Lake City's venues include the Union, Kilby Court and Metro Music Hall, with the Utah Symphony at Abravanel Hall and Sundance crowds passing through each January.

cities.name: San Antonio
cities.blurb: San Antonio's calendar runs along the River Walk and the Pearl — Paper Tiger, the Aztec Theatre, the Tobin Center — with Fiesta taking over the city for ten days in April.

cities.name: San Diego
cities.blurb: San Diego mixes the Casbah and Soda Bar with Old Globe theater in Balboa Park and Humphreys' bayside summer concert series.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.blurb: San Francisco's rooms include the Fillmore, Great American Music Hall and the Chapel, with SFJAZZ, A.C.T. and Davies Symphony Hall clustered in the civic center.

cities.name: Santa Barbara
cities.blurb: Santa Barbara's calendar centers on the Arlington and Granada theaters, nightly music at SOhO, and the international film festival each winter.

cities.name: Seattle
cities.blurb: Seattle's clubs — Neumos, the Crocodile, the Tractor Tavern — sit beside the Seattle Symphony at Benaroya, Seattle Rep, and Bumbershoot at Seattle Center.

cities.name: Sonoma
cities.blurb: Sonoma County's events are winery- and harvest-driven, with concerts at Gundlach Bundschu and Jack London State Historic Park alongside club nights in Santa Rosa and Sebastopol.

cities.name: Spokane
cities.blurb: Spokane's calendar runs through the Fox Theater, the Knitting Factory and the Bing Crosby Theater, with Hoopfest filling downtown streets each June.

cities.name: St. Louis
cities.blurb: St. Louis keeps a strong blues and rock circuit — Off Broadway, the Duck Room under Blueberry Hill, Delmar Hall — with the Fabulous Fox and Powell Hall on Grand.

cities.name: Stamford
cities.blurb: Stamford's events cluster at the Palace Theatre and Stamford Symphony, with Alive@Five summer concerts and Curtain Call's year-round theater.

cities.name: Tampa
cities.blurb: Tampa's Ybor City carries the club calendar — the Ritz, the Crowbar — with the Straz Center, Amalie Arena and Gasparilla's pirate invasion each January.

cities.name: Traverse City
cities.blurb: Traverse City's summer fills with the National Cherry Festival, while the City Opera House and nearby Interlochen Center for the Arts book shows year-round.

cities.name: Tucson
cities.blurb: Tucson's calendar runs along Fourth Avenue and Congress Street — Hotel Congress, the Rialto — with the Gem Show in February and Tucson Meet Yourself in October.

cities.name: Washington
cities.blurb: Washington's rooms range from the 9:30 Club and Black Cat to the Kennedy Center and the Anthem, with free Library of Congress and Smithsonian programming most weeks.

cities.name: Wenatchee
cities.blurb: Wenatchee's events center on the Numerica Performing Arts Center and Town Toyota Center, with the Apple Blossom Festival each spring.

cities.name: Wilmington NC
cities.blurb: Wilmington pairs Greenfield Lake Amphitheater and Brooklyn Arts Center shows with Thalian Hall theater and riverfront festivals downtown.

cities.name: Worcester
cities.blurb: Worcester's venues include the Palladium's metal and hardcore bills, Mechanics Hall's 19th-century acoustics, and the Hanover Theatre for touring Broadway.
